# Revolix Technologies
> AI agents and automation that ship to production.

## About Revolix Technologies
Revolix Technologies is an AI engineering company based in Karachi, Pakistan, with a registered office in Wyoming, USA (Revolix Technologies LLC). Our team of around 20 engineers builds production AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), voice AI receptionists, and CRM automation.

## Core Capabilities
- **AI Agents & Multi-Agent Workflows:** Autonomous agents built on LangGraph, CrewAI, and custom orchestration.
- **AI Voice Agents:** Inbound and outbound conversational voice agents for appointment booking and customer support (HVAC, healthcare, home services).
- **RAG & Knowledge Assistants:** Custom retrieval-augmented generation over enterprise documents and internal databases.
- **CRM & Marketing Automation:** Advanced GoHighLevel (GHL) workflows, custom webhooks, and sales funnels.
- **Custom Software & Cloud:** FastAPI, Node.js, Next.js, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, and Kubernetes.
- **Proprietary Product (Vursell):** Multi-channel AI sales platform for WhatsApp, voice, web chat, and LinkedIn.
